envelope.description: Type the TASK and TASKS payload codecs

body.title: Type the TASK and TASKS payload codecs
body.summary: Add src/workflow/tasks/types.ts with TaskPayload (title, summary, size, order, acceptanceChecks, tests, planTaskId), TasksPayload (planRevision, taskIds, nextNumber), TaskSetError and TaskStructureError, and replace the pass-through bodies of the TASK and TASKS codecs in src/workflow/artifact-core/codecs.ts with decoders that refuse a malformed body.
acceptanceChecks: The TASK and TASKS codecs round-trip a typed payload and refuse a body with a missing or wrongly typed field
TaskPayload carries planTaskId and TasksPayload carries planRevision, taskIds and nextNumber
No other kind's codec changes behaviour

tests.name: tasks-codec.test.ts: the TASK and TASKS codecs round-trip a Task payload and a Tasks payload and refuse a malformed body
